description: Angular component for a bar chart widget with labels, including initialization, styling, and interaction logic.

classes.name: BarChartWithLabelsWidgetComponent
classes.description: Angular component implementing a customizable bar chart with labels, supporting legend and data updates.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes component settings, styles, and legend configuration.

methods.name: ngAfterViewInit
methods.description: Creates the time series chart after the view is initialized.

methods.name: ngOnDestroy
methods.description: Destroys the time series chart to prevent memory leaks.

methods.name: onInit
methods.description: Sets overlay style border radius based on widget element.

methods.name: onDataUpdated
methods.description: Updates the chart when data changes.

methods.name: onLatestDataUpdated
methods.description: Refreshes the chart with the latest data.

methods.name: onLegendKeyEnter
methods.description: Handles mouse enter event on legend key.

methods.name: onLegendKeyLeave
methods.description: Handles mouse leave event on legend key.

methods.name: toggleLegendKey
methods.description: Toggles visibility of a data key in the chart.
